6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeMonoBridgeField
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffFraming
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffStalkEval
9	
10	/-!
11	# The field-level window-recovery mono is CARRIER-FREE — the widened separation rung
12	needs no widened mathematics
13	
14	Reviewer finding `I-1248` reports that the R2 widened carrier `DivFamZarAff`
15	(`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffZar.lean:165`) has a certificate producer and **no classifier
16	tower**, and names the missing rungs as the classifier, the characterizing clause, and
17	**separation** — calling the last load-bearing, because separation is what lets `ofPull`
18	derive `pull_classify`.  The reading it invites is that the widened separation is
19	chart-typed mathematics awaiting a widened re-proof.
20	
21	**This file measures that reading and it is wrong at the bottom of the chain.**  Follow
22	the chart-typed separation down:
23	
24	`eq_of_isDivRepClassify` (`Picard/DivRepClassifyZarSep.lean:352`)
25	  → `divFam_divEq_of_eps_eq_total` (`Picard/DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel.lean:417`)
26	  → `divFam_divEq_of_eps_eq'` (`Picard/DivSchemeMonoBridge.lean:434`)
27	  → `CertifiedDivisorFamily.windowGen` (`…MonoBridgeRel.lean:334`)
28	  → `CertifiedDivisorFamily.stalkIdeal_le_span_windowGerm_of_field`
29	    (`Picard/DivSchemeMonoBridgeField.lean:193`).
30	
31	In that last proof the carrier `G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C K π g` occurs **only** as
32	`G.eqns` and as `DivFam.mk G` under `divFamEps` / `divFamEpsWindowGermSet` — and both of
33	those are, by `rfl`, functions of `G.eqns` alone (`divFamEps` is `divisorWindow F.eqns` at
34	two windows, `DivisorFamilyWindow.lean`).  The adaptation, the certificate, the cover and
35	the chart typing never enter.
36	
37	**One correction to that sentence, and it is not cosmetic** (review-ajcr's I-1336 makes the
38	same point against a sibling file): `divisorWindow` is independent of the ADAPTATION — which
39	cover refines `d` — but it is NOT free of the pinned chart pair.  Unfolded, it is a
40	`Submodule.comap` of `d.vanishingSubmodule` at `(relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀` and
41	`.V₁`, and `fiberTwoCover π` IS the pinned affine two-chart cover.  So the right statement is
42	*adaptation-free and carrier-free, relative to a fixed pinned pair* — which is what the R2
43	widening needs, since R2 widens the certificate's cover and leaves the window's pair alone.
44	Anywhere below that this file says "carrier-free", read it in that sense.
45	
46	So the field-level rung does not depend on WHICH carrier certified the divisor: it is a
47	statement about a bare
48	`d : (relCurve C K).LocalEquations`, and what the certificate is used for is exactly two
49	facts about the presentation divisor of `d`:
50	
51	* `deg_K (presentationDivisor K d.presentation) = g`, and
52	* its effectivity `0 ≤ presentationDivisor K d.presentation`.
53	
54	Both are available on the **widened** side already, the first being
55	`AffAdaptation.IsCertified.deg_presentationDivisor` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffStalkEval.lean`,
56	no separation and no cover hypothesis) and the second the general
57	`Scheme.zero_le_coeffAt_presentationDivisor`.
58	
59	## What this file proves, and what it does NOT
60	
61	* `eqns_stalkIdeal_le_span_windowGermSet_of_field` — the window generation over a field
62	  for an **arbitrary** local-equation system whose presentation divisor is effective of
63	  degree `g`.  No carrier, no adaptation, no cover.
64	* `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.stalkIdeal_le_span_windowGerm_of_field`,
65	  `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.windowGen_of_field`,
66	  `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.divEq_of_eps_eq_of_field` — the widened instances, the last
67	  being the widened field mono: **two widened certified families over a field with equal
68	  `ε`-pairs cut divisor-equal systems**.
69	* `DivFamZarAff.mk_eq_mk_of_eps_eq_of_field` — the same read at the widened quotient.
70	
71	It does **not** produce the widened classifier, the widened characterizing clause, or
72	`exists_certChartCover` widened (that is `framecover-aff`, held by `ajcr-p1`), and it does
73	not discharge `(divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy` — which still has zero producers.  Nor
74	does it touch `IsChartUniv`, Zariski-local surjectivity, or `rep`.  What it removes is one
75	named rung from the widened tower's bill, by showing the rung was never carrier-specific.
76	
77	**The `Field` restriction is real and is not hidden**: this is the field-level rung.  The
78	general-test rung `CertifiedDivisorFamily.windowGen` (`…MonoBridgeRel.lean:334`) reduces
79	the arbitrary-`R` case to this one at each residue field, and *that* reduction does use
80	the adaptation — through `G.adaptation.index`, `stalkIdeal_eq_span_germ_eqn` and
81	`FinCoverData.windowRes`.  So the widened general-test rung is a separate obligation and
82	this file states it as owed rather than closed; see `## The general-test rung is owed`.
83	-/

/-- **The germ set of the `ε`-window of a divisor family at a point**: the germs at `z`
of the chart components of the global theta sections in the family's embedding window
`ε₁ = K_M(d)` (read through the window identification `relThetaWindowEquiv`).  Depends
only on the functor value `F : DivFam C R π g` — in particular two families with equal
`ε`-pairs have the SAME germ sets. -/
noncomputable def divFamEpsWindowGermSet (g : ℕ) (F : DivFam C R π g)
    (z : relCurve C R) : Set ((relCurve C R).presheaf.stalk z) :=
  Scheme.twistGermSet
    ((↑(Submodule.map (relThetaWindowEquiv C R π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
        (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)).toLinearMap ((divFamEps hπ g F).1)) :
      Set (relThetaSections C R π (windowM_choice π hπ g)))) z

/-- **The easy inclusion at the family level**: window germs lie in the stalk ideal —
the window is the preimage of the vanishing submodule, whose membership clauses are the
germ conditions. -/
lemma span_divFamEpsWindowGermSet_le (g : ℕ) (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π g)
    (z : relCurve C R) :
    Ideal.span (divFamEpsWindowGermSet hπ g (DivFam.mk G) z)
      ≤ G.eqns.stalkIdeal z := by
  refine span_twistGermSet_le_stalkIdeal G.eqns ?_ z
  have h0 : (divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G)).1
      = divisorWindow G.eqns (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g) := rfl
  have h1 : Submodule.map (relThetaWindowEquiv C R π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
        (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)).toLinearMap ((divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G)).1)
      = G.eqns.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
          (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁
          (relThetaCocycle C R π (windowM_choice π hπ g)) := by
    rw [h0, divisorWindow]
    exact Submodule.map_comap_eq_of_surjective
      (relThetaWindowEquiv C R π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
        (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)).surjective _
  rw [h1]

/-- The Jacobian of a smooth, proper curve over a field `k`. -/
noncomputable def Jacobian (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
  sorry

namespace Jacobian

/-! ## The Jacobian of `C` is an abelian variety. -/

-- data
/-- The group scheme structure on the Jacobian of the curve `C`. -/
noncomputable instance instGrpObj : GrpObj (Jacobian C) :=
  sorry

/-- The Jacobian of `C` is smooth of relative dimension `g` over `k`, where `g` is the
genus of `C`. -/
instance smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (genus C) (Jacobian C).hom :=
  sorry

/-- The Jacobian of `C` is proper over `k`. -/
instance : IsProper (Jacobian C).hom :=
  sorry

/-- The Jacobian of `C` is geometrically irreducible over `k`. -/
instance : GeometricallyIrreducible (Jacobian C).hom :=
  sorry

/-- The Abel-Jacobi map from a smooth, proper curve to its Jacobian associated
to a `k`-rational point of `C`. -/
noncomputable def ofCurve (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C) : C ⟶ Jacobian C :=
  sorry

/-- The Abel-Jacobi map sends the `k`-rational point `P` to `0`, where `0` (denoted by `η`) is the
neutral element of the group scheme `Jacobian C`. -/
theorem comp_ofCurve (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C) :
    P ≫ ofCurve P = η[Jacobian C] :=
  sorry

/--
The universal property of the Jacobian variety: For any abelian variety `A`, any morphism
`f : C ⟶ A` with `f(P) = 0` factors uniquely through the Jacobian of `C`. In other words,
`Jacobian C` is the Albanese variety of `C`.
-/
theorem exists_unique_ofCurve_comp (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C)
    {A : Over (Spec (.of k))} [Smooth A.hom] [IsProper A.hom] [GrpObj A]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom] (f : C ⟶ A) (hf : P ≫ f = η[A]) :
    ∃! (g : Jacobian C ⟶ A), f = ofCurve P ≫ g :=
  sorry
